optimization.action_description: Add probe_fp4_gemm_layout.py to test SM103 FlashInfer CUTLASS mm_fp4 as a building block and to check whether real G11 FlashInfer/TRT-LLM prepared weights can be consumed directly by the generic CUTLASS FP4 GEMM API.
optimization.expected_impact: Constrain the next custom grouped-GEMM implementation: generic 128x4 CUTLASS FP4 GEMM is available on SM103, but the true prepared-weight layout needs a TRT-LLM-compatible prepared-layout path rather than a direct call to ordinary CUTLASS mm_fp4.
optimization.risks_and_rollback: The probe imports FlashInfer lower-level GEMM APIs only for evidence; it is not used by kernel.py and does not change candidate behavior.

profile_evidence.evidence_summary: On NVIDIA L20D/SM103, dense 128x4 NVFP4 mm_fp4(cutlass) runs for M=8,N=2048,K=4096 at 96.704 us. Directly feeding true G11 prepared gemm1 weights to generic cutlass mm_fp4 produced a non-finite stage1 sample at tokens=8; tokens=128 produced finite samples but still has no correctness proof. Prepared stage probes were around 93-105 us per single-expert dense GEMM.
profile_evidence.evidence_chain: FlashInfer mm_fp4(cutlass) confirms SM103 FP4 Tensor Core dense GEMM is callable, but true G11 weights/scales from prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe are TRT-LLM prepared/shuffled. The generic cutlass entry expects its documented 128x4 layout and is not a drop-in replacement for the prepared MoE layout. Therefore the next candidate must implement or wrap a prepared-layout grouped GEMM/finalize path, not just substitute ordinary dense CUTLASS GEMMs into the scalar MoE.

correctness.details: probe_fp4_gemm_layout.py passed Python syntax checks. Dense CUTLASS sanity produced finite output; prepared-layout probes were not correctness gates and one tokens=8 stage1 sample was NaN.

quality_gate.failure_reason: This iteration records a necessary layout finding and a reproducible probe, but it does not yet replace the scalar candidate stages or meet the objective of beating flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

next_step.description: Build a custom prepared-layout grouped GEMM path that uses routing_pack_type1 metadata, preserves FlashInfer/TensorRT-LLM row/scale shuffles, quantizes the SwiGLU intermediate, and fuses stage2 finalize/scatter.
